text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho, and the energy from the stands can be felt in the runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The boisterous cheers are enough to make even Mihono Bourbon feel restless, but I manage to help her calm down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower joins us, bolstered with a strong sense of determination. In response, the usually stoic Mihono Bourbon gets spirited, and declares her own unyielding desire to win.
